allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the approval of allotment of 17058082 Equity shares pursuant to Rights Issue by the Fund-Raising Committee at its meeting held on October 23, 2026

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Intimation of closure of the Issue period of the Rights Issue of NATCO Pharma Limited (the  Company )

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Fund Raising Committee Meeting approving the Letter of Offer for Rights Issue

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on September 25, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 21, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 21 Equity Shares held at an Issue Price of  Rs. 750 per share (including a premium of ₹ 748/- (Rupees Seven Hundred and Forty Eight only) per Rights Equity Share)

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation regarding receipt of In-Principle Approval for the Rights Issue '.
